text_block_list.text:
Having run through the Classics, the day 
of the grand year-end showdown, the Arima 
Kinen, has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where powerhouses from 
both the Classic and Senior Years 
gather...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's no way this won't be fun! I'm 
itching to get out there and run!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Just watch, I'll charge through in the 
lead against the very best!"
choice_data_list: Go and become a Grand Prix Uma Musume!
Come back as a Grand Prix Uma Musume!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay! The one bringing the fever to the 
podium is gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa... The paddock is packed full of 
spectators too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky! Show us that out-of-this-world 
running again today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'm rooting for you, so do your best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh!? You're the one who ran with me in 
the Asahi Hai...

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a spectator today, but... 
Still...!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll run alongside you again, 
Maruzensky-san! I'll definitely catch up!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering for you with all my heart 
today, so please win!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the kind of ultimate run 
that makes you want to chase after me!
